questions.question: Do you want the manager monitoring/reporting decisions, and how?

options.label: One-shot dashboard now
options.description: Run `manager` once against current sessions to show their states + what it would decide right now. No persistent process. Spawns an investigator only if something's actually waiting.

options.label: Start background shadow loop
options.description: Launch `manager --loop` (180s, submit off) as a background process from the main checkout, logging decisions to a logs dir. Lives with this session; spawns investigators per waiting session each tick.

options.label: Set up persistent service
options.description: Stand up a launchd agent so it monitors across sessions/reboots (the deferred #22 item). Bigger setup; I'd do it dry-run-first like the usage-monitor.

options.label: Leave it off for now
options.description: Keep nothing running; revisit when the live-answering blocker (#22) is resolved.
